verdict.rationale: Zoho MCP is a documented official MCP server (mcp.zoho.com) that explicitly connects LLMs like GPT/Claude to Zoho Books' APIs and actions, with customer testimonials confirming real-world use for invoicing, bookkeeping, and reporting via Claude. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of the MCP server working (testimonials are vendor-curated), and technical setup/connection docs beyond marketing copy.
